entity_name: South Lebanon Water Establishment (مصلحة مياه لبنان الجنوبي)

facts.value: Supply, distribution, and network maintenance of water for South Lebanon and Nabatieh governorates.
Governorates covered: South Lebanon, Nabatieh. HQ in Sidon.
Hotline: 1785. Department contacts: Sidon 07-757000, Zahrani 07-420206, Jezzine 07-781725, Nabatieh 07-530018, Bint Jbeil 07-450006, Marjeyoun-Hasbaya 07-830016, Tyre 07-740196.
